rule: Every SDK_VERSION bump gets an entry here the same day. Pin sdk.js?v=NNN and require window.kcc20.sdkVersion === that NNN.

entries.title: Apps grid — iOS icons, KasOdds, docs then Open App
notes: You → Apps is a compact 4-up icon grid. Tap an app for a docs sheet (Overview / Features / Workflow / Start), then Open App. KasOdds (kasodds.com) added. Faceless Studio removed from the grid. KBUILD, vProg TTT, and Forge use the official Kaspa mark. Proof of Fact has its own icon.

entries.title: Dot.K Connect opens their PWA
notes: connect({ identity, origin }) pops origin/index.html?dapp=1. discoverWallets() merges kcc20-sdk.vercel.app/dotk-wallets.json. useWallet / resolveDotk / listDotk / connectDotk.
Guide steps 7–9: strip Scorpion Home chrome, demo-dapp loads HOST/sdk.js, register identity → origin. Pin sdk.js?v=178.

entries.title: Dot.K wallets — discover .k on Connect
notes: Page: kcc20-sdk.vercel.app/dotk.html. Vibe-code a PWA from KCC20-wallet. KCC20_DOTK + KCC20_RDNS announce identity on kaspa:announceProvider.
dApps: kcc20.discoverWallets(), connect({ identity: 'alice.k' }), getIdentity(). Pin sdk.js?v=177.

entries.title: Forge presets: Scorpion, Pay me, Family, Terminal, Trader, Artist, .k
notes: One-click layout templates with real structure and palettes. Tap Scorpion desk, Pay me, Family, Terminal, Trader, Artist, or .k identity. Then drag, restyle, Test.
SDK 176 unchanged.

entries.title: Forge restyle actually paints the canvas
notes: Restyle stamps screenshot colors onto every card (inline styles). QR on top / tokens under KAS move blocks. Works without XAI_API_KEY.
SDK 176 unchanged.

entries.title: Forge agent, drag-place, own-wallet Test
notes: Forge chat + screenshot upload restyles the face (palette locally, Grok /api/forge when keyed). Drag cards to reorder; left/right/full columns. Receive QR draws in the preview. Test opens YOUR generated wallet overlay, not Scorpion chrome.
SDK 176 unchanged.

entries.title: Forge page on the SDK site
notes: Public page: https://kcc20-sdk.vercel.app/forge.html and https://kcc-20-wallet.vercel.app/forge.html. Nav: Home · Docs · Forge. window.kcc20.forge.url points at /forge.html.
Pin sdk.js?v=176.

entries.title: Wallet Forge — drag live Kaspa primitives
notes: You → Apps → Wallet Forge. Drag brand (official Kaspa mark), identity, KAS, KCC20, activity, receive, send, TTT, network onto a canvas. Dropped blocks read this wallet for real. Edit/delete in preview. Export HTML that uses sdk.js?v=175.
window.kcc20.forge and request('forge'). AI does not generate keys. Pin sdk.js?v=175.

entries.title: KasSigner dual QR + Face ID
notes: You → KasSigner: optional dual sign. Desktop PIN, then QR. iPhone Scorpion scans, Face ID (WebAuthn) or PIN, signs, QR back. Pattern from InKasWeRust KasSigner (M5), without flashing an M5.
Applies to dApp signPskt when the toggle is on and you are on desktop. KasWare/Kaspire path unchanged. SDK 174 unchanged.

entries.title: Pay with Kaspire when Kaspire is on
notes: KRON Review buy / Compound / COOK confirm say Pay with Kaspire when that extension is the signer. KasWare label only when KasWare is on.
SDK 174 unchanged.

entries.title: KasWare toggle is KasWare only
notes: You → KasWare no longer stays on because Kaspire is signing. Kaspire is a different extension. Turning Kaspire on leaves the KasWare switch off.
SDK 174 unchanged.

entries.title: VEYRA protocol docs in the wallet
notes: You → Settings → VEYRA opens the protocol in the PWA: three rooms, request vs authority, what this wallet signs, BYO KasWare/Kaspire, agents, fork. Lock screen also links veyra.html.
SDK 174 unchanged.

entries.title: VEYRA in the SDK + fork the wallet
notes: Additive. window.kcc20.veyra and request('veyra') / getVeyra return the Phase 6 descriptor (silent, no popup). connect, signPskt, buyKron, getActivityLog unchanged.
Spec: /veyra.html and VEYRA.md. Fork Scorpion instead of a blank app: FORK.md and github.com/mrzeku2000XTTT/KCC20-wallet.
Pin sdk.js?v=174. window.kcc20.sdkVersion === '174'.

entries.title: Kaspire extension signing
notes: You → Settings → Kaspire. Detects window.kaspire (isKaspire). Toggle Sign with Kaspire. Connect uses requestAccounts; PSKTs use signPskt like KasWare.
Only one extension signer is on at a time. Keys stay in Kaspire. SDK 173 unchanged.

entries.title: vProg TTT spends TN10 KAS like izio
notes: You → Apps → vProg TTT on testnet-10: Create / Join / tap your turn builds the same encoder-wasm lane carriers as vprogs-tt.izio.fr. PIN signs. Keys stay in Scorpion.
Need TN10 KAS in one UTXO covering 0.5 KAS stake + fee. SDK 173 unchanged.

entries.title: Practice uses TN10 vProg guest rules
notes: Practice match is guest/src/program/rules.rs: X opens every round, seats swap marks on odd rounds, 1/3/5 rounds, early clinch, draw splits the 0.5 KAS stake display. You are seat 0, Scorpion seat 1.
SDK 173 unchanged.

entries.title: vProg TTT: tap Practice to play
notes: You → Apps → vProg TTT now has a Practice board you tap (you X, Scorpion O). Live TN10 boards stay watch-only.
SDK 173 unchanged.

entries.title: vProg Tic-Tac-Toe testing lane in Apps
notes: You → Apps → vProg TTT reads the live Kaspa vProgs tic-tac-toe DA (biryukovmaxim/vprog-tictactoe, public TN10 lane vprogs-tt.izio.fr).
Shows covenant, deposit address, open/playing/finished boards, and this PIN key's rollup id. Create/Join/Turn stay encoder-wasm carriers in the guest repo.
SDK 173 unchanged. Hard-refresh until BUILD 263.

entries.title: Sent tokens leave Home immediately
notes: After Send all KKDAG (or any KCC20), Home / Tokens drop that row right away. A stale KRON/kascov balance can no longer put the token back for minutes.
Zero-balance rows are hidden. The live KRON tokenlist is the source of truth; the slower kascov catalog no longer resurrects spent cells.
SDK 173 unchanged. Hard-refresh until BUILD 262.

entries.title: iPhone PIN can send KCC20
notes: Home → Send KCC20 on iPhone (Safari / PWA) uses the same in-app PIN key as Send KAS. KasWare is a desktop extension and is not required on phone.
BUILD 259 compared the PIN key to the wallet address via payToAddressScript(publicKey), which throws, so nativeOk stayed false and the phone showed No in-app key.
SDK 173 unchanged. Hard-refresh until BUILD 261, then Send the token with PIN.

entries.title: KRON buy survives a dead Kaspa explorer
notes: Pay with PIN no longer dies when api.kaspa.org is unreachable. Quote already comes from the KRON indexer; BUILD 260 uses that same head (realKas, tokenReserve, last trade txid) if the explorer lookup times out.
Explorer lookup now has a 7s timeout and retries the official REST host. KDIST/KRON curve and graduated pool buys assemble without waiting on Cloudflare.
SDK 173 unchanged. Hard-refresh the wallet before the next buy.

entries.title: KCC-12 announce + What’s new page
notes: Additive only. connect, signPskt, buyKron, getActivityLog, pushTx, trusted origins, and signing boundaries are unchanged from 172.
Announces kaspa:announceProvider (KCC-12 draft) with rdns app.kcc20.wallet. Still fires kaspa:provider for the older KIP-12 name.
provider.request({ method, params }) maps kaspa_requestAccounts → connect and kaspa_signTransaction → signPskt + signInputs.
window.kcc20.request('buyKron', opts) two-arg form still works.
PSKB and kaspa_signMessage stay 4200.
Commit 5d68109 (sdk 173). This page added so integrators can see every SDK bump.

entries.title: getActivityLog + KasWare compound fee
notes: SDK 172: getActivityLog() / activityLog() for Nilla evidence — buys[].buyTxId, receiveTxId, pending. Empty hashes stay pending.
Connect snapshot includes activityLog. Read-only; origin must already be allowed.
BUILD 255: KasWare Compound sizes fee from compute mass and retries if the node asks for more (the 700000 vs 722600 reject).
BUILD 254: stop replaying Received-token toasts. BUILD 253: storage quota + Activity Notices tab.

entries.title: quoteKron is not silent
notes: quoteKron is interactive. After Connect, do not call quoteKron as a silent method — it used to throw Connect KCC20 Wallet first.
Official KRON buy: buyKron / tradeKron on user click. Wallet quotes on Approve.
signInputs.index is global tx.inputs[]. pushTx returns { txId, node }.

entries.title: sendKaspa + openWallet
notes: sendKaspa self-send Sign sheet.
openWallet for TTT standalone unlock.
